what_happened: The job asked to give job introspections the unmet criteria, findings and failed checks. That is, the introspection writer would see why a job failed. It ended rejected. The verifier's verdict was fail, with 2 of 6 acceptance criteria unmet and 1 blocker or major finding. The stored fields don't say which criteria failed or what the finding was. Earlier introspections had the same blind spot.
cause: Nothing in the job compared the work to each acceptance criterion before the final verifier ran. Two gaps therefore surfaced only at the end, when rejection was the only option. The request named inputs to pass along (criteria, findings, failed checks) but not an observable result. For example, it did not say that an introspection of a rejected job must name the specific unmet criterion. The build could not tell when it was done. This is a partial inference, because the unmet criteria are not in the stored fields. The same missing detail is why this record is vague.
prevention: Add a check during the build, before final verification. It runs each acceptance criterion as a concrete test and reports unmet ones to the builder while there is still time to fix them. Record the unmet criteria and findings in the rejection event, so later introspections can name them. For this request, the reading should state the observable outcome: an introspection of a rejected job contains the text of each unmet criterion and each blocker or major finding.
proposed_request: Make job introspections show why a job failed. When a job ends rejected or failed, the introspection input must include the text of each unmet acceptance criterion, each blocker or major finding, and each failed check, taken from the verifier's stored result. Acceptance: (1) given a rejected job with 2 unmet criteria and 1 blocker finding, the introspection input lists all three by text, not just counts; (2) given a job with no failures, the input has no empty failure section; (3) a test covers both cases and passes; (4) if the stored result lacks the details, the input says so explicitly. Run each criterion as a check before final verification, and fix any that fail.
